title: Senior Front End Developer (LATAM)
description:
Lateral stands for technology excellence.

We’re a profitable, award-winning design and technology company with over 20 years of experience launching bold ventures and transforming businesses. A globally distributed team of 200+ experts united by a shared purpose: the continuous pursuit of quality.

Our clients come to us for results, quality and craft - and stay because we keep raising the bar.

We do things differently at Lateral

Our mission is simple:design and build great products .
What sets us apart isn’t just the talent of our team - it’sthe way we work:

We Have A Bias For Action & Results.

We are doers - we spot the gaps, connect the dots, anticipate what’s around the corner and take action. We move fast, stay focused, and let the results - not the effort - speak for themselves.

We Work On Time, On Budget, On Quality

Discipline is our edge - a commitment we make to each other, to our clients, and to the standards we hold ourselves to

We Care Deeply.

We care about our work and about each other. Care Is A Competitive Advantage.

Every detail matters. Every design, every line of code, every decision. Thoughtful by default.

We Do Things Right - Because It’s the Right Thing to Do

Right over easy. Integrity isn’t up for negotiation. We hold the bar high even when no one’s watching. We take pride in doing great work the right way - not the easy way.

We Keep Improving

The best teams keep improving and we’re never done learning.

We iterate. We reflect on what’s working and what’s not. Feedback fuels us, we receive it openly, and adapt quickly. Progress over perfection.

We’re Obsessed With Agility, Not The Agile Manifesto

We don’t chase dogma or rituals - we chase momentum. We adapt processes to fit problems, not the other way around.

We Take Ownership
Everyone leads something here. You will have room to run with ideas, and the trust to execute. That trust is built on how you show up: thinking things through, sweating the details, and following through.

What You’ll Do

As a SeniorFront End Developer at Lateral, you will:

  • Craft delightful digital experiences: Design, implement, and maintain front-end features using React and modern JavaScript/TypeScript. You’ll create reusable UI components and craft polished, responsive interfaces with a focus on quality

  • Collaborate & communicate: Work closely with designers, back-end developers, and product managers in an asynchronous workflow. You’ll regularly communicate with clients to clarify requirements, demo features, and ensure we’re building the right thing.

  • Lead and take ownership: As a senior member, you’ll drive projects from concept to completion. That means making technical decisions, outlining implementation plans, and seeing them through deployment. You’ll have the freedom to introduce new ideas and best practices that raise the bar for our front-end, whether it’s improving our build process or adopting an innovative UI approach – all justified by real benefit to the team and product.

  • Optimize, Iterate & improve: Involve yourself in brainstorming and technical discussions. Ensure our apps are fast, accessible, and reliable. You’ll profile and improve page load times, refine animations, and tackle browser-specific quirks so that every user gets a smooth experience. When issues arise, you’ll dive in to debug and fix them, striving for robust solutions that scale (and writing tests to prevent regressions

  • Mentor and learn: Guide and mentor junior developers by sharing your expertise and providing constructive feedback. At the same time, stay curious and keep up with industry trends, frameworks, and standards. You’ll be encouraged to continuously learn and bring in knowledge, evaluating new technologies thoughtfully to see if they can enhance our product or developer experience (we love learning, but avoid “innovation for innovation’s sake”). In short, you’ll help shape a culture of excellence, ownership, and growth on the team.


Example Projects You May Join:

  • Large scale B2B2C Commerce Platform: Help build a responsive, mobile-first experience for an international e-commerce client. For example, you might lead a dynamic multi-faceted search or a smooth checkout flow

  • Develop from scratch an application: Collaborate with a senior backend engineer/architect to build a modern application. You’ll be involved in everything from crafting components to API definition.

  • Real-Time Medical Dashboard: Develop front-end features for a real-time analytics dashboard for a pet healthcare client. You might use libraries like AGCharts to visualize large data sets, implement live updates via websockets, and ensure the interface remains highly performant and user-friendly.

Whatever the challenge, you’ll be building software that changes lives and moves industries forward.

How we measure success in this role

In the first two weeks

  • You've set up your development environment and tools.

  • You’ve pushed your first meaningful contribution (bugfix, UI tweak, or minor feature).

  • You’re familiar with our async workflows and communication style.

  • You’ve participated in your first client sync and started understanding the project's context.

In the first 3 months:

  • You’ve led development on a significant feature or initiative.

  • You’ve actively mentored a teammate or shared knowledge through code review or documentation.

  • You’ve authored or contributed to architectural decisions and design documents.

  • You’ve established trust with clients through clear communication and technical guidance.

  • You’ve improved performance, code structure, or tooling in meaningful ways.

After 3 months:

  • You’re recognized as a technical leader in your project or team.

  • You’ve initiated a broader improvement across projects (e.g., shared component library, new testing standard).

  • You’re frequently unblocking teammates, elevating code quality, and proactively identifying risks.

  • You balance speed and quality, delivering with care and clarity.

We measure success through:

  • The impact and scope of your technical contributions.

  • Your ability to lead initiatives, mentor others, and improve team practices.

  • Code quality, performance, and maintainability.

  • Positive feedback from peers, clients, and design/engineering leadership.

  • Your growth mindset, communication skills, and influence on team culture.

What We’re Looking For

We are seeking for team members who are both highly technical and deeply care about their craft and how the work gets done. You must bring:

  • 7+ years of professional front-end development experience building digital applications. Experience with modern Javascript libraries and tooling (e.g. React, npm, webpack...). Fluency in CSS and first-principles understanding front end technologies.

  • Proven ability to craft ,polish ,delight , sweat the details.
    You have an eye for design and UX. Pixel-perfect isn’t just a phrase to you – you care about creating beautiful, intuitive interfaces that make users happy. An understanding of design principles and attention to details like accessibility and responsive layout is important.

  • Quality and reliability
    You take pride in building high-quality software. You’re diligent about testing and documentation, and you proactively debug issues before they become problems. Performance and browser compatibility matter to you – you know how to make a web app fast and handle the quirks of different environments . Ultimately, you balance speed of delivery with maintainability, ensuring the code you ship today won’t be tech debt tomorrow.

  • Self-driven and accountable: You’re comfortable managing your own projects and time without heavy oversight. When you take on a task, we can count on you to see it through with a sense of ownership. You’re a proactive problem solver who can break down complex problems, propose solutions, and drive them to completion. We trust our team members to be “managers of one” who take initiative and deliver results.

  • Great communication and empathy are a must. You enjoy working closely with others, be it in pair programming, brainstorming with designers, or reviewing a teammate’s code. You can explain technical concepts clearly, listen to alternate viewpoints, and work together to find the best solutions. Our culture is about beingkind, open, and constructive , so we’re looking for someone who lifts others up and thrives in a friendly, collaborative environment.

  • Remote work skills: Self-motivated and disciplined in a remote environment. You can manage your time, collaborate asynchronously, and aren’t afraid to ask questions or offer help across time zones.

Bonus points for:

  • Demonstrating craft

  • Design /delight sensibility

  • AI & Gen AI experience/tooling

  • Understanding Backend concepts

  • CSR/SSR

  • DevOps experience (continuous integration, hosting, etc.)

Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • Real Impact: You’ll work on meaningful products that make a measurable difference - from healthcare and commerce to sustainability and next-gen tech.

  • Remote-First, Office Friendly: Work from wherever you’re most productive - whether that’s your home, a co-working space, or one of our offices. We’re a remote-first company, but if you’re near an office, you’re welcome to drop in, collaborate in person, or work onsite regularly.
    We prioritize async collaboration, respect your time zone, and focus on outcomes over hours.

  • An Outstanding Team: Talented, kind, and hard-working people who care deeply about their craft - and about each other. No egos. No politics. Just professionals doing their best work.

  • Growth: You’ll be supported in growing your craft, exploring new paths, and stepping into greater responsibility - at your own pace

  • A Culture of Excellence: We care deeply about doing the right thing - for our clients, our team, and ourselves. No burnout. No crunch. Just high-quality work, delivered sustainably.

  • Variety & Stability: We’re profitable, independent, and over a decade strong. Yet every project brings a fresh challenge. You’ll never be bored here.

This Role Might Not Be for You

We want to respect your time by being clear about what this role isn’t. You should skip this opportunity if:

  • You prefer well defined structure. If you gravitate towards a clear hierarchy, well defined roles and swim lanes, you may find our self-managed style challenging.

  • Distributed work isn’t your thing. If you find async communication, design documentation and being proactive without a manager nearby difficult, our setup won’t suit you.

  • Feedback doesn't excite you. We’re obsessed with quality and believe in continuous improvement. That means we give feedback that’s sometimes nitpicky. If refining the work until it’s excellent feels over the top, you are likely going to find working here frustrating.

  • Change makes you uncomfortable. We’re scaling and maturing. That means not everything is perfect yet. Priorities shift. Processes evolve. If ambiguity is uncomfortable, this may feel bumpy.

However, If this sounds like fuel, we’d love to talk!

How to apply and what to expect in the interview process

Our hiring process is structured as a sequence of steps. Moving forward is based on how well the previous step goes. This helps us stay focused, fair, and respectful of everyone’s time.

We will always:

  • Let you know clearly what the next step is

  • Share updates and feedback wherever possible

  • Invite questions if anything feels unclear

Not everyone progresses through every stage. That doesn’t mean you’re not great at what you do. Sometimes it’s about timing, team fit, or simply what we’re looking for at the moment.

Step 1: Express Your Interest with a Portfolio

Ifthis sounds like your kind of team and you’re excited to bring your craft to Lateral, we’d love to hear from you.

Please send us:

  • Abrief note telling us what excites you about this role

  • Your Portfolio / Links to your work —Essential. This could be URLs, GitHub repos, code snippets, portfolio sites — anything that gives us insight into your craft

  • Your resume

A few tips:

  • Highlight any areas that made your work special

  • Avoid sharing anything sensitive or proprietary

  • If you’re sharing team projects, be sure to highlight your specific contributions

We’re not looking for perfection — we’re looking for insight into your thinking, creativity, and craft. Just show us your thinking, your process, and what you’re proud of.

We review every application with care. If there’s a fit, we’ll reach out to schedule next steps.

Step 2: Talent Partner Conversation

Purpose: A structured discussion with our People Experience team to delve into your career trajectory, motivations, and alignment with Lateral's values.

What to Expect:

  • In-depth questions about your past experiences and decision-making processes.

  • Exploration of your career goals and how they align with the role.

  • Discussion about our company culture, availability, compensation and other logistics

  • Motivators and demotivators.

  • Your life outside coding.

Preparation Tips:

  • Reflect on your career journey and pivotal moments.

  • Be ready to discuss challenges you've overcome and lessons learned.

  • Familiarize yourself with the Job Description, Lateral's mission and values.

Step 3: Take Home Assignment

Purpose: Provide a practical demonstration of your skills through a task resembling real work at Lateral.

Format: A paid for take-home assignment or a live session, depending on the role.

What to Expect:

  • Tasks designed to reflect actual challenges faced in the position.

  • An opportunity to showcase your problem-solving and technical skills.

Preparation Tips:

  • Set aside uninterrupted time to focus.

  • Explain your decisions and assumptions.

Step 4: Technical interview

Purpose: Assess your technical proficiency and problem-solving abilities.
Format: A collaborative session with our engineering team, focusing on real-world scenarios relevant to the role.

What to Expect:

  • Problem-solving exercises/questions that mirror tasks you'd encounter in the position.

  • Discussions around your approach, reasoning, and solutions.

Preparation Tips:

  • Practice articulating your thought process clearly and concisely.

  • Be prepared to discuss in depth past projects and the technologies used.

Step 5: Operational interview

Purpose: Understand your approach to prioritizing, collaborating, shipping, and iterating.

What to expect:

  • How you prioritize and break down work.

  • How you collaborate across disciplines.

  • How you handle blockers, feedback, and iteration.

Preparation Tips:

  • Pick 1-2 meaningful projects you led or heavily contributed to.

  • Walk through your process: what worked, what didn’t, what you’d do differently.

  • Think about how you manage time, scope, and changing requirements.

Step 6: Reference Checks

Purpose: We believe references are about understanding, not just validation. We do not look for perfection, but to understand patterns, strengths, and context. We use them to learn how to support you best.

What to Expect: we’ll ask you for 2–3 people who’ve worked closely with you. These are often: former managers, senior peers or collaborators, mentors or people you've mentored.

What we ask: We focus on how you’ve grown, where you shine, how you like to be led, and what support sets you up for success. We want practical advice for making this a great fit for you.

Yes, we do backchannels too: We do thiswhen we feel we need more context . We will check with you if there are folks we should avoid reaching out due to confidentiality or other reasons. Andhere’s our commitment: if anything surprising or unclear comes up in a backchannel, we’ll bring it directly to you. We believe in “no stories without you in the room .” You’ll always get the chance to share your side, context, or clarification.

Step 7: Offer

What Happens: If selected, you'll receive a comprehensive offer detailing compensation, and other pertinent information.

Our hiring process is designed to be thorough yet respectful, ensuring a mutual fit. We encourage candidates to engage actively, ask questions, and view this as a two-way exploration.

Join us and let’s build something extraordinary.

  • Conhecimento em gestão de contratos e fornecedores de TI será um diferencial;

Additional information

Como é o processo seletivo na PRIO?

Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura :)

Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. description:
Business Analyst / Requirements Engineer

122493

About Us

Zurich Insurance Company is a leading provider of insurance products and services, committed to delivering innovative solutions and exceptional customer service. Our ZCAM (Zurich Customer Active Management) team turns customer data into practical business solutions to drive the implementation of our ambitious customer strategy.

If you are a talented, dynamic and experienced Data Analyst, passionate about connecting the dots and have a strong background in technology, we would love to hear from you.

So make a difference. Be challenged. Be inspired. Be supported, Love what you do. Work with us.

The opportunity: Business Analyst / Requirements Engineer

As a Business Analyst, you will help ZCAM’s customers by understanding their needs and developing solutions to business problems. You will work with multidisciplinary and international teams to gather requirements, document processes, and communicate findings. Your responsibilities will include collecting and documenting business needs, analyzing data to identify trends and insights, suggesting process improvements, creating reports and presentations for stakeholders, and collaborating with teams to implement solutions. Additionally, you will be key to ensure that project objectives align with business goals, and will lead meetings and workshops to drive project success. Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills are essential for this role.

Responsibilities

  • Understands customers objectives, processes and products in order to make appropriate recommendations for customer-specific needs during incubation, delivery and operations
  • Plans, conducts and facilitates incubation sessions for business requirements gathering with subject matter experts and end users ensuring deliverables are met
  • Adapts and applies different delivery methodologies determining the best methodology for the specific project
  • Contributes to business cases, including cost / benefit analysis, risk assessment, project scope definition and development of a high-level schedule
  • Produces requirement specifications and outlines solution design documents throughout the project life cycle, incorporating change requests and finalization of requirements documentation
  • Analyzes and manages requirement risk, traceability matrix and prioritizes requirements
  • Performs quality review checks on project deliverables
  • Participates in development of test plan, testing, implementation and training activities
  • Participates in post implementation activities including problem solving and measurement of benefits achieved
  • Communicates effectively through different mediums at all levels
  • Creates compelling project documents such as business cases, including cost / benefit analysis, risk assessment, project scope definition and development of a high-level schedule
  • Manages interdependencies within the projects and other functions
  • Communicates effectively through different mediums at all levels

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, engineering or science or a related field, any higher degree is an advantage
  • Professional experience in related role and/or demonstrated competency (projects) utilizing relevant technologies
  • Balanced mix of business acumen as well as affinity to technology and systems
  • Innovative and creative self-starter, highly motivated, business and IT savvy
  • Independent and able to handle multiple tasks and deadlines
  • Must possess in-depth, strong problem-solving analytical skills with attention to detail
  • Experience in the delivery of business solutions in time, quality, and budget
  • Proven experience as business analyst or subject matter expert in global projects and/or sound knowledge in insurance business
  • Proven track with project management & software development methodologies (e.g. Agile, SCRUM, ITIL, PMP)
  • Tough-minded, highly flexible and determine to deliver assigned targets
  • Good interpersonal and communication skills
  • Experience in application testing and organizing user acceptance testing
  • Customer-oriented team player with good communication abilities, fostering effective collaboration and teamwork
  • Strong proficiency in both English and Portuguese is required, Spanish language skills are a plus.

Additional Information

We look forward to receiving your online application.

Zurich wants to attract the best talent and we acknowledge that talents might not always be available full-time. At Zurich we will consider requests for flexible working. Many of our employees work flexibly in a variety of ways. Please talk to us during the interview about the flexibility you may need.

  • Alinhar toda a comunicação das ofertas de acordo com as dores de cada segmento de acordo com a jornada de compra, da aquisição à retenção.

A Serasa Experian é muito mais do que você imagina. A gente se dedica muito em ser uma das melhores e mais inovadoras empresas para se trabalhar do país, possibilitando experiências e carreiras incríveis para nossas pessoas. Nossa forte abordagem de pessoas em primeiro lugar é reconhecida externamente por meio de diversas certificações de mercado: fomos premiados pelo Great Place To Work em 24 países e pela certificação internacional Top Employers, além de sermos reconhecidos como uma das melhores empresas para jovens profissionais e contarmos com uma avaliação de 4,6 no Glassdoor.   • Garantir a confidencialidade, organização e rastreabilidade de todos os documentos sob sua responsabilidade, com foco em compliance e boas práticas de gestão da informação.

At IPS, we are global leaders in developing innovative solutions for the consulting, architecture, engineering, project controls, procurement, construction management, and CQV of technically complex facilities, primarily in the life sciences industry. We are looking for a dedicated Senior Administrative Assistant to join our team at our office located in São Paulo, Brazil.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Handle and direct phone calls, emails, and correspondence professionally and in fluent English, ensuring efficient communication with clients, suppliers, and national and international partners.
  • Welcome visitors, suppliers, and external teams, providing logistical and administrative support to internal staff and engineers.
  • Manage the control of office supplies, technical materials, and equipment, ensuring timely restocking and organized inventory.
  • Maintain organized common areas and coordinate the supply of office and cleaning materials to support operational routines.
  • Create, update, and maintain administrative and technical databases, physical and digital filing systems, reports, records, and project documentation.
  • Proficiently use Microsoft Office tools (Excel, Word, PowerPoint), as well as corporate systems such as Ariba, Concur, and SAP, in support of engineering project routines.
  • Support internal and institutional communication activities, including presentations, marketing materials, and corporate events, while adhering to branding and technical standards.
  • Organize business travel, technical visits to construction sites, and external events, as well as manage reimbursement and expense reporting processes.
  • Assist in the preparation, review, and formatting of technical and commercial proposals in both Portuguese and English, ensuring compliance with company standards.
  • Support contract management (clients and suppliers), invoice control, purchase orders, and administrative documents related to engineering projects.
  • Participate in project meetings by drafting detailed minutes, tracking action items, and facilitating communication between technical and administrative teams.
  • Coordinate logistics and structure for internal events, training sessions, and meetings with internal and external stakeholder

    Additional Responsibilities:
  • Support the management of contracts with technical suppliers and service providers, ensuring compliance with deadlines, scopes, and contractual terms.
  • Assist in controlling and presenting administrative and operational indicators related to projects and departmental performance.
  • Collaborate in the implementation and continuous improvement of internal processes, administrative workflows, and quality policies.
  • Serve as a link between technical teams (engineering, projects, production) and support departments (finance, procurement, HR, legal), promoting integration and workflow efficiency.
  • Manage the onboarding process for new employees, especially interns and junior engineers, by organizing logistics, documentation, and access to corporate tools.
  • Ensure the confidentiality, organization, and traceability of all documents under your responsibility, with a focus on compliance and best practices in information management.

Only candidates who meet the qualifications outlined in the job description will be considered by IPS.

  • Profissional com mais de 10 anos de experiência em rotinas administrativas no setor de engenharia, atuando no suporte direto a equipes
  • técnicas, projetos multidisciplinares e áreas corporativas.

  • Professional with over 10 years of experience in administrative routines within the engineering sector, providing direct support to technical teams,
  • multidisciplinary projects, and corporate departments.
  • Fluent in English, capable of handling communication with international stakeholders, understanding technical documentation, and supporting the preparation of reports and presentations in English.

About Us

IPS, a Berkshire Hathaway Company, is a global leader in developing innovative business solutions for the biotechnology and pharmaceutical industries. Through operational expertise and industry-leading knowledge, skill, and passion, IPS provides consultancy services, architecture, engineering, project controls, construction management, and compliance services that allow clients to develop and manufacture life-impacting products. Its newest acquisition, Linesight, specializes in cost, schedule, risk, program, and project management services in various market sectors, including data centers, life sciences, and high-tech industries. With the addition of Linesight, IPS has over 3,000 professionals in over 45 offices across 17 countries in the Americas, Europe, Asia Pacific, Southeast Asia, Australia, and the Middle East.

Process Architecture, Process Design, Engineering, Construction, Commissioning, Qualification, LEAN Project Delivery, Strategic Master Planning, Energy Conservation Management, Project Controls, Program/Project Management, Operations/Logistics Strategy and Planning, EPCMV and Staffing Services.

Your wellbeing matters. Join a company that cares.

GET TO KNOW US

Wellhub (formerly Gympass*) is a corporate wellness platform that connects employees to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep, all included in one subscription designed to cost less than each individual partner. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in NYC, we have a growing global team in 11 countries. At Wellhub, you have the opportunity to build a career in a high-growth tech company that places wellbeing at the foundation of its culture, and contribute to making every company a wellness company.

With our refreshed identity, we are poised to embark on an exciting new chapter of growth and expansion. We are elevating our offerings, including a completely new app experience and an expanded network of wellbeing partners. Learn more about it here.
THE OPPORTUNITY

Our CX Quality team, part of CX Enablement, works to constantly elevate the overall customer experience by ensuring consistently high-quality interactions across all channels. We achieve this by meticulously monitoring external customer satisfaction (e.g., CSAT) and internal agent performance, providing actionable, data-driven insights to empower CX leadership, optimize operational processes, and continuously refine our quality assurance efforts for scalable growth.
This team should provide insights and recommendations to CX leadership and also other internal areas, leading actionable plans to improve customer experience towards excellence.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Team Development: Manage and develop a team of CX Quality analysts & coordinators, fostering their professional growth and ensuring high performance.
  • Strategic Leadership: Develop and execute a comprehensive CX quality strategy aligned with overall business objectives and customer experience goals.
  • Quality Program Management: Design, implement, and manage robust quality assurance programs to guarantee continuous quality monitoring for all customer-facing operations (internal teams and third parties BPOs).
  • Performance Monitoring & Analysis: Establish key performance indicators (KPIs) and metrics for CX quality. Regularly monitor, analyze, and report on quality performance, identifying trends, root causes of issues, and areas for improvement.
  • Voice of the Customer Advocate: Partner with CX and other support teams to integrate customer feedback into quality processes, ensuring insights drive continuous improvement.
  • Coaching & Training Support: Collaborate with training and CX operations teams to develop and deliver targeted coaching, training materials, and best practices based on quality findings to enhance agent performance and customer interactions.
  • Process Improvement Mindset: Collaborate with other teams to identify and optimize inefficient or ineffective customer journeys and internal processes that impact CX quality. Champion a culture of continuous improvement and new technologies optimization.
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life balance.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Languages: Fluent in Portuguese and English.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in a STEM field (Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics) or a related discipline.
  • Leadership Experience: you have experience in leading and developing teams.
  • Customer Experience (CX) and Quality Assurance (QA) experience: Proven experience in monitoring CX operations, with a focus on efficiency and quality improvement, including quality monitoring, calibration, and performance management.
  • Analytical & Customer-Focused: You are data savvy and have experience in improving customer experiences.
  • CX & Quality Expertise: Proven experience in Customer Experience (CX) with a track record of driving quantifiable improvements in key metrics like CSAT, NPS, and CES.
  • Advanced Data Analysis: Highly proficient in Excel (PivotTables, Charts, statistical functions) for large, complex datasets, ensuring data quality and actionable insights.
  • Familiarity with statistical concepts and experience in SQL, Looker Studio, Power BI, or Python as a plus.
  • Process Improvement & Quality Methodologies: Knowledge of process improvement methodologies such as Lean Six Sigma, COPC or other quality certifications a strong advantage.
  • AI Enthusiast: Eager to explore and apply Artificial Intelligence to enhance quality processes and agent performance.
  • Strategic & Influential Leader: Strong leadership presence, inspiring and motivating cross-functional teams and senior stakeholders while anticipating future trends and developing long-term strategies.
  • Data-driven and Analytical: Leverages a robust analytical mindset and meticulous attention to detail to interpret complex data, identify trends, and translate insights into actionable recommendations.
  • Customer-Centric Advocate: Deeply dedicated to enhancing the customer experience and influencing others to prioritize customer satisfaction.
  • Exceptional Communicator: Explains complex changes clearly to diverse audiences, concisely summarizing data and insights, telling compelling stories, and presenting impactful recommendations.
  • Proactive Problem-Solver: Anticipates issues and implements solutions to prevent negative customer impacts. Able to turn incomplete or ambiguous inputs into clear action plans.
  • Highly Collaborative: Works effectively with various teams and influences stakeholders, building strong relationships across departments.
  • Adaptable & Dynamic: Thrives in fast-paced, dynamic environments and readily adapts to changing business needs and priorities.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that proficiency in English and leadership experienceare mandatory requirements.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

We're a wellness company that is committed to the health and wellbeing of our employees. Our flexible program allows you to customize your benefits, according to your needs!

Our benefits include:

WELLNESS: Health, dental, and life insurance.

FLEXIBLE WORK: At Wellhub, flexibility fosters a happier, healthier, and more productive work environment for everyone. As a Flexible First company, we offer two work model options: flexible hybrid and full remote, and make the office a place for collaboration, community, and team building. The model for this role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Wellhubbers and their leaders can make the best decisions for their scope. This includes flexibility to adjust their working hours based on their personal schedule, time zone, and business needs.

WELLHUB: We believe in our mission and encourage our employees and their families to take care of their wellbeing too. Access onsite gyms and fitness studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental health support, and more. You will receive the Gold plan at no cost, and other premium plans will be significantly discounted.

PAID TIME OFF: We know how important it is that our employees take time away from work to recharge. Vacations after 6 months and 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + extra day off for your birthday.

PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life and we want our employees to take the time to be present and enjoy their growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents and extended maternity leave.

CAREER GROWTH: Outstanding opportunities for personal and career growth. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do and invest deeply in employee development.

CULTURE: An exciting and supportive atmosphere with ambitious people from around the world! You’ll partner with global colleagues and share in the success of a high-growth technology company disrupting the health and wellness space. Our value-based culture of trust, flexibility, and integrity makes this possible every day. Find more info on our careers page !

And to get a glimpse of Life at Wellhub… Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and LinkedIn !

Louis Dreyfus Company is a world leader in the processing of agricultural products & the merchandising of a diverse range of commodities. Founded & based in Europe, Louis Dreyfus Company enjoys strong regional presence in North & South America, Europe, Asia, Middle East & Africa.


To support its growing needs, Louis Dreyfus Company has launched a global ERP program named BOLD – BackOffice Louis Dreyfus and based on SAP S4Hana solution. This ERP program covers the following supply chain processes:
- Procurement processes supported by SAP MM connected to ARIBA solution and FIORI user interface.

- Equipment repair & maintenance supported by SAP PM.
- Production Planning & Execution supported by SAP PP.

- Sales & distribution process supported by SAP SD.
- Transportation management supported by SAP TM.


In this context of multi-year global ERP programs, Louis Dreyfus is in search of SAP Sales & Distribution Solution Manager to support the rollout in Brazil which is one of the largest LDC scopes.


While developing skills related to LDC’s sales & distribution business process in S/4 Hana solution, you will have the possibility to become a change agent and play a key role on our ambitious SAP Program.


We invite you to join our team if you strive to make a difference with your contribution & establish yourself as an inspiring member of our DT&A organization.

As a Sr. Solution Specialist, you are the referent for the SAP sales and distribution solution.

title: Governo do Estado nomeia 842 educadores
description:
A iniciativa tem como foco a valorização do magistério para garantir uma educação pública de qualidade.

O Governo do Estado publicou, na edição extra do Diário Oficial do Estado (DOE) desta sexta-feira (28), a relação dos 842 educadores aptos a serem nomeados, após aprovação e convocação no concurso público regido pelo Edital Saeb n° 03/2022. Este total refere-se as portarias de convocação, atrelados às 4ª, 5ª e última convocação para entrega de documentação para fins de nomeação.

A publicação destaca que são 387 professores e 151 coordenadores pedagógicos, que correspondem à 4ª convocação e mais 222 professores e 82 coordenadores pedagógicos, da 5ª convocação. Após a nomeação, a ser realizada pelo governador Jerônimo Rodrigues, os educadores terão o prazo de até 30 dias – contados da data da publicação do ato de nomeação no órgão oficial – para tomar posse.

Os candidatos nomeados para as escolas pertencentes ao Núcleo Territorial de Educação Salvador e Região Metropolitana (NTE 26) deverão comparecer à sede da Secretaria da Educação do Estado da Bahia, situada na Av. Luiz Viana Filho, nº 550, 5ª Avenida, Centro Administrativo da Bahia – CAB, 1º andar, sala 117. Já os candidatos aprovados para o interior do Estado deverão se dirigir para as sedes dos NTEs. É necessário apresentar documentação pessoal com foto.

O último concurso recebeu mais de 103 mil inscritos, divididos nos 27 Núcleos Territoriais de Educação, situados em Salvador e em outros 26 municípios do Estado. Foram ofertadas 2.113 vagas, sendo 1.806 para professores, 289 para o cargo de coordenador pedagógico e 18 para coordenador pedagógico indígena. Dos 4.923 habilitados no concurso, todos já foram convocados. Com a nova nomeação, já foram chamados 4.297 profissionais da Educação.

Why You Should Join the Service Experts Team?

Our team consists of the very best; we believe in doing what is right for our customers and our employees. We provide our employees with the training, support and an opportunity for unlimited professional growth. Join us and become an EXPERT!

Position Summary:

The Dispatcher is responsible for coordinating the daily scheduling and dispatching of field technicians to job sites. This role serves as the primary point of contact between customers and field staff, ensuring efficient communication and timely service while prioritizing jobs based on urgency and availability. The ideal candidate will possess strong multitasking abilities, excellent customer service skills, and proficiency in dispatching software to streamline operations and meet service level agreements.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Answers incoming phone calls from customers and assists call or routes call to appropriate person
  • Maintains good customer relations and ensures that all calls meet Service Experts’ standards
  • Receive and prioritize incoming service requests from customers, carefully documenting details related to the issue and location.
  • Utilize dispatching software to efficiently schedule and assign field technicians to job sites based on their availability, skill set, proximity to the location, and service call priority.
  • Monitor technicians' schedules and job progress throughout the day, making necessary adjustments and reassignments to maximize productivity and ensure timely service.
  • Act as the main point of contact between customers and field staff, providing updates on technician arrival times, service status, and addressing any customer inquiries or concerns.
  • Maintains customer records by updating account information
  • Adheres to CPI compliance regulations when taking payments over the phone
  • Updates capacity planner whenever calls or booked, rescheduled or cancelled
  • Continually maintains working knowledge of all company products, services, and promotions
  • Reliable attendance and on-time job performance

Qualifications:

  • Experience or training the use of computers and related systems in an administrative office environment
  • Must be able to multi-task and work effectively in fast-paced and constantly changing work environment. Must be comfortable switching rapidly between tasks with no loss in efficiency and effectiveness.
  • Excellent customer-service, communication, and interpersonal skills
  • Effective communication skills to communicate with customer and to resolve customer issues, complaints, or concerns
  • Ability to effectively communicate with co-workers and customers in a pleasant, business-like, and customer-focused manner. Ability to communicate with a diverse customer population.
  • Ability to work effectively in both a team and an independent environment
  • Ability to make decisions based on established guidelines and procedures

  • Effective organizational and time-management skills. Must be able to prioritize work based on service demands

Why are you being asked to complete this form?

We are a federal contractor or subcontractor. The law requires us to provide equal employment opportunity to qualified people with disabilities. Completing this form is voluntary, and we hope that you will choose to do so. Your answer is confidential. No one who makes hiring decisions will see it. If you want to learn more about the law or this form, visit the U.S. Department of Labor’s Office of Federal Contract Compliance Programs (OFCCP) website at .

How do you know if you have a disability?

A disability is a condition that substantially limits one or more of your “major life activities.” If you have or have ever had such a condition, you are a person with a disability. Disabilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Alcohol or other substance use disorder (not currently using drugs illegally)
  • Autoimmune disorder, for example, lupus, fibromyalgia, rheumatoid arthritis, HIV/AIDS
  • Blind or low vision
  • Cancer (past or present)
  • Cardiovascular or heart disease
  • Celiac disease
  • Cerebral palsy
  • Deaf or serious difficulty hearing
  • Diabetes
  • Disfigurement, for example, disfigurement caused by burns, wounds, accidents, or congenital disorders
  • Epilepsy or other seizure disorder
  • Gastrointestinal disorders, for example, Crohn's Disease, irritable bowel syndrome
  • Intellectual or developmental disability
  • Mental health conditions, for example, depression, bipolar disorder, anxiety disorder, schizophrenia, PTSD
  • Missing limbs or partially missing limbs
  • Mobility impairment, benefiting from the use of a wheelchair, scooter, walker, leg brace(s) and/or other supports
  • Nervous system condition, for example, migraine headaches, Parkinson’s disease, multiple sclerosis (MS)
  • Neurodivergence, for example, attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD), autism spectrum disorder, dyslexia, dyspraxia, other learning disabilities
  • Partial or complete paralysis (any cause)
  • Pulmonary or respiratory conditions, for example, tuberculosis, asthma, emphysema

title: Finance Manager - Brazil
description:
Why should you join dLocal?

dLocal enables the biggest companies in the world to collect payments in 40 countries in emerging markets. Global brands rely on us to increase conversion rates and simplify payment expansion effortlessly. As both a payments processor and a merchant of record where we operate, we make it possible for our merchants to make inroads into the world’s fastest-growing, emerging markets.

By joining us you will be a part of an amazing global team that makes it all happen, in a flexible, remote-first dynamic culture with travel, health and learning benefits, among others. Being a part of dLocal means working with 1000+ teammates from 30+ different nationalities and developing an international career that impacts millions of people’s daily lives. We are builders, we never run from a challenge, we are customer-centric, and if this sounds like you, we know you will thrive in our team.

What's the opportunity?

As the Finance & Operations Manager for Brazil, you will oversee all local financial operations and ensure full compliance with Brazilian regulatory frameworks. You will lead Treasury, Accounting, and Foreign Exchange (FX/e-FX) functions, playing a strategic and operational role in supporting the company’s growth while maintaining financial integrity and regulatory alignment.


What will you be doing?
  • Lead and manage all financial operations in Brazil, including Treasury, Accounting, and FX/e-FX activities.
  • Ensure full compliance with Brazilian financial regulations (e.g., Banco Central, CVM), acting as the primary liaison with regulators, auditors, and external partners.
  • Design and implement robust financial controls, reporting frameworks, and treasury strategies aligned with both local regulations and global standards.
  • Monitor and manage cash flow, liquidity, capital requirements, and investment strategies to support operational and regulatory needs.
  • Oversee statutory financial reporting, tax compliance, and timely submission of all regulatory financial filings.
  • Collaborate closely with global Finance, Legal, and Compliance teams to ensure consistency between local practices and group-wide strategies.
  • Provide financial insights, risk assessments, and recommendations to support business growth and decision-making.
  • Represent the company in regulatory audits, board-level discussions, and relevant industry forums.
What skills do you need?
  • 8+ years of senior financial leadership experience within regulated financial institutions in Brazil (e.g., banks, payment institutions, fintechs).
  • In-depth knowledge of Brazilian financial regulations (BACEN) with a track record of regulatory engagement.
  • Proven experience managing Treasury, Accounting, and FX operations in complex or high-growth environments.
  • Strategic mindset with the ability to build and execute scalable financial frameworks.
  • Hands-on leadership style, capable of both operational deep dives and high-level financial strategy.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, both internally and externally.
  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.
  • A master's degree, an MBA, or a CPA/CRC certification is a strong plus.
  • SAP knowledge is a plus.
  • Full professional fluency in English is required.

What do we offer?

Besides the tailored benefits we have for each country, dLocal will help you thrive and go that extra mile by offering you:

Description & Requirements

Bloomberg runs on data. Our products are fueled by powerful information. We combine data and context to paint the whole picture for our clients, around the clock – from around the world. In Data, we are responsible for delivering this data, news and analytics through innovative technology - quickly and accurately. Our products run on intelligence and industry-specific insights provided by the industry teams. We are dedicated to crafting a best-in-class financial analysis and modeling product while constantly looking to enhance and expand our existing offering through a deep understanding of the markets we operate in, the sectors we cover, and our clients current and future needs.

What’s the role?

The Company Financials Market Data team is looking for a Senior Market Data Analyst who combines strong relationship management, market insight, and regulatory awareness to lead product development to incorporate regional nuances and relevance to the respective markets. This role focuses on understanding financial market structure, maintaining strong partnerships, and ensuring data quality and timeliness to support our suite of Company Financials products. You will work cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, and other Company Financials teams, helping shape the direction of our data offerings in response to client demand and market developments.

We’ll trust you to:

  • Monitor and interpret financial regulations, exchange rule changes, and emerging trends to ensure Bloomberg’s Company Financials data offering remains compliant, competitive, and market-leading.

  • Maintain and grow relationships with exchanges and third-party data vendors across multiple geographies to secure access to critical data sources and insights.

  • Lead initiatives to improve and expand market data coverage, helping design and manage structured projects aligned with business and client needs.

  • Collaborate closely with internal stakeholders (Engineering, Product, Financial Product, Compliance) to translate market needs into actionable data strategies.

  • Act as a subject matter expert on specific markets or data types, guiding how financial filings and disclosures are sourced, processed, interpreted, and used across Bloomberg platforms.

  • Contribute to the development of automation and monitoring tools by offering business insight and data structure understanding; some familiarity with Python or scripting is welcome.

  • Create and maintain clear documentation, business rules, and operating procedures to support team scalability and transparency.

  • Represent the Company Financials team in external engagements such as working groups, regulatory consultations, and client feedback sessions.

You’ll need to have:

  • Minimum 3+ years of experience in financial markets, particularly within market data, exchanges, investor relations, or regulatory environments.

  • A bachelor’s degree or higher in Finance, Economics, Business, or a related field.

  • Deep understanding of company filings, financial disclosures, and market data structures.

  • Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and drive results across teams.

  • Proven track record of external stakeholder management and relationship building.

  • A proactive mindset with strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills in English, with an ability to distill complex issues for a variety of audiences.

We’d love to see:

  • Familiarity with the Bloomberg Terminal, Company Financials products, and/or Bloomberg’s data management workflows.

  • Experience working with or within financial exchanges or regulators.

  • Knowledge of key global financial reporting regimes (e.g. IFRS, US GAAP).

  • Exposure to data science or coding tools (e.g., Python, SQL) to support data exploration and project work.

  • Multilingual skills or experience working in a global context.

Your wellbeing matters. Join a company that cares.

Wellhub (formerly Gympass*) is a corporate wellness platform that connects employees to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep, all included in one subscription designed to cost less than each individual partner. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in NYC, we have a growing global team in 11 countries. At Wellhub, you have the opportunity to build a career in a high-growth tech company that places wellbeing at the foundation of its culture, and contribute to making every company a wellness company.

*Big news: Gympass is now Wellhub!
We are thrilled to announce our rebranding as Wellhub, marking a significant milestone in our journey. This transformation reflects our evolution from a “pass for gyms” to a comprehensive employee wellbeing solution. With our refreshed identity, we are poised to embark on an exciting new chapter of growth and expansion. We are elevating our offerings, including a completely new app experience and an expanded network of wellbeing partners. Learn more about it here.

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Senior CX Quality Manager to our CX Global team in São Paulo !

Our CX Quality team, part of CX Enablement, works to constantly elevate the overall customer experience by ensuring consistently high-quality interactions across all channels. We achieve this by meticulously monitoring external customer satisfaction (e.g., CSAT) and internal agent performance, providing actionable, data-driven insights to empower CX leadership, optimize operational processes, and continuously refine our quality assurance efforts for scalable growth.
This team should provide insights and recommendations to CX leadership and also other internal areas, leading actionable plans to improve customer experience towards excellence.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Team Development: Manage and develop a team of CX Quality analysts & coordinators, fostering their professional growth and ensuring high performance.
  • Strategic Leadership: Develop and execute a comprehensive CX quality strategy aligned with overall business objectives and customer experience goals.
  • Quality Program Management: Design, implement, and manage robust quality assurance programs to guarantee continuous quality monitoring for all customer-facing operations (internal teams and third parties BPOs).
  • Performance Monitoring & Analysis: Establish key performance indicators (KPIs) and metrics for CX quality. Regularly monitor, analyze, and report on quality performance, identifying trends, root causes of issues, and areas for improvement.
  • Voice of the Customer Advocate: Partner with CX and other support teams to integrate customer feedback into quality processes, ensuring insights drive continuous improvement.
  • Coaching & Training Support: Collaborate with training and CX operations teams to develop and deliver targeted coaching, training materials, and best practices based on quality findings to enhance agent performance and customer interactions.
  • Process Improvement Mindset: Collaborate with other teams to identify and optimize inefficient or ineffective customer journeys and internal processes that impact CX quality. Champion a culture of continuous improvement and new technologies optimization.
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life balance.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Languages: Fluent in Portuguese and English.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in a STEM field (Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics) or a related discipline.
  • Leadership Experience: you have experience in leading and developing teams.
  • Customer Experience (CX) and Quality Assurance (QA) experience: Proven experience in monitoring CX operations, with a focus on efficiency and quality improvement, including quality monitoring, calibration, and performance management.
  • Analytical & Customer-Focused: You are data savvy and have experience in improving customer experiences.
  • CX & Quality Expertise: Proven experience in Customer Experience (CX) with a track record of driving quantifiable improvements in key metrics like CSAT, NPS, and CES.
  • Advanced Data Analysis: Highly proficient in Excel (PivotTables, Charts, statistical functions) for large, complex datasets, ensuring data quality and actionable insights.
  • Familiarity with statistical concepts and experience in SQL, Looker Studio, Power BI, or Python as a plus.
  • Process Improvement & Quality Methodologies: Knowledge of process improvement methodologies such as Lean Six Sigma, COPC or other quality certifications a strong advantage.
  • AI Enthusiast: Eager to explore and apply Artificial Intelligence to enhance quality processes and agent performance.
  • Strategic & Influential Leader: Strong leadership presence, inspiring and motivating cross-functional teams and senior stakeholders while anticipating future trends and developing long-term strategies.
  • Data-driven and Analytical: Leverages a robust analytical mindset and meticulous attention to detail to interpret complex data, identify trends, and translate insights into actionable recommendations.
  • Customer-Centric Advocate: Deeply dedicated to enhancing the customer experience and influencing others to prioritize customer satisfaction.
  • Exceptional Communicator: Explains complex changes clearly to diverse audiences, concisely summarizing data and insights, telling compelling stories, and presenting impactful recommendations.
  • Proactive Problem-Solver: Anticipates issues and implements solutions to prevent negative customer impacts. Able to turn incomplete or ambiguous inputs into clear action plans.
  • Highly Collaborative: Works effectively with various teams and influences stakeholders, building strong relationships across departments.
  • Adaptable & Dynamic: Thrives in fast-paced, dynamic environments and readily adapts to changing business needs and priorities.

We're a wellness company that is committed to the health and wellbeing of our employees. Our flexible program allows you to customize your benefits, according to your needs!

PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life and we want our employees to take the time to be present and enjoy their growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents and extended maternity leave.

CAREER GROWTH: Outstanding opportunities for personal and career growth. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do and invest deeply in employee development.

CULTURE: An exciting and supportive atmosphere with ambitious people from around the world! We’re looking for a results-driven and experienced Head of Digital Advertising Strategy to join our team.

The Head of Digital Advertising Strategy position at Common Thread Collective (CTC) plays a key role in scaling our clients’ success. It centers on creating accurate forecasts to drive our clients toward their goals, followed by meticulously executing strategies to materialize these goals daily.

Your actions and decisions embody CTC’s Global core values, serving as a guiding force for these principles. At CTC, your trained expertise is invaluable, covering the entire spectrum of CTC’s Strategic Forecasting methods and the foundational principles of media acquisition.

Your role goes beyond delivering tangible business results; it involves a proactive engagement with our clients, ensuring transparent communication regarding the actions undertaken and the performance relative to the forecasts. This ongoing dialogue not only fosters trust but also cements the partnership between CTC and its clients, guiding them through the complexities of media acquisition and strategic planning.

You stand as a representative and zealous advocate for CTC's distinctive approach to media acquisition and its accompanying tools.

As a Head of Digital Advertising Strategy, you lead by example and set a high standard.

You view challenges as opportunities to excel and take great pride in your ability to drive results with precision and impact. At CTC, we embrace the mantra, “Everyday in Everyplay, Count on Me,” meaning we take ownership, deliver excellence, and see things through to the end.

WHAT WE LOOK FOR

This place isn’t for everyone, but it might be for you if…

Our core values are the heart and soul of this incredible Company. The right person for this role will appreciate each of these values, personally subscribe to them, and understand why each is critical to having a great business.

To give ourselves our best shot at accomplishing Our mission, we organize all of our decisions—from recruiting, to hiring, to raises, to promotions, to how we spend our time and money—in the direction of three committed values.

We recognize these values aren't for everyone.

They're challenging. In fact, they're so challenging, that's why we invest so much in supporting our team and why we tend to attract people who are craving the opportunity to do more at work than get a paycheck. We're looking for those who are interested in making their work significant.

  • Your openness to both offer and embrace feedback as an opportunity for growth and implement it proactively, without needing constant direction.

COMPETITIVE GREATNESS

  • Adapts to changing circumstances, recognizing that true success is about not just meeting, but exceeding what is required.

What Success Looks Like

NECESSARY SKILLS

TRAINING PERIOD

ONBOARDING

  • Ability to organize, prioritize, and manage multiple tasks with great attention to detail.

  • Building a Growth Forecast for your clients
    • Building a Growth map using the Prophet System

  • The Daily Execution and Actualisation vs the Forecast.

CONTRIBUTING BACK

Impact

  • Thrives in environments where they can see the direct results of their actions on the business, with a strong preference for roles that offer full accountability and autonomy.

Results

You will merge the Finance and Marketing sides of a business to build a forecasted strategy to help the business achieve its goal.

  • Meet all deadlines and budget requirements, ensuring timely and on Target Performance.
  • Contribute valuable ideas to team discussions and company-wide content, supporting growth and innovation.

DOMAIN

MANAGEMENT

  • Your supervisor would be Joy Sharma, The Director of the CTC Accelerator Program.

title: Operador(a) de Produção I
description:
Redução de emissões nocivas de veículos. Potencialização de futuros veículos. Dando nova vida aos metais usados.

Continuamos a fornecer soluções de materiais sustentáveis que atendem às megatendências globais e são essenciais para a vida cotidiana. Nossos produtos e serviços aceleram a transformação da mobilidade global, atendem à crescente necessidade de materiais avançados e permitem uma circularidade ainda maior para metais críticos. Somos a empresa líder em tecnologia de materiais circulares, cumprindo sua missão de criar valor sustentável por meio de materiais para uma vida melhor.

Com ambições como essa, imagine, o que você poderia fazer?

Sobre a produção PMR

Os recursos do planeta são escassos. A tecnologia de refino e reciclagem da Umicore dá aos metais usados um novo ciclo de vida. Somos especialistas no tratamento dos materiais mais complexos em todo o mundo. Nossos processos ajudam a agregar valor à economia circular, além de reduzir os impactos ambientais. Para recuperar a maior quantidade de metal a partir de diferentes tipos de material, não podemos ficar parados. Precisamos encontrar novas maneiras de trabalhar, descobrindo novas soluções e desenvolvendo novos processos. E é aqui que você entra.

O que você fará

Operar equipamentos tais como fornos elétricos, indução e a gás, moinhos, peneiradores, homogeneizadores, trituradores, filtros ambientais, equipamentos de transporte de materiais, controle de efluentes e sua recuperação.

Atuar na segregação e controlar a geração interna de recicláveis e não recicláveis.

Manter a organização e limpeza dos postos de trabalho, visando garantir a segurança operacional dos processos e atendimento dos requisitos produtivos para os diversos materiais a serem processados, recebidos dos clientes externos e internos, atendendo prazos e garantindo a qualidade do processo e produto.

Operar equipamentos providos de sistemas automatizados e supervisórios, realizando cálculos e ajustes de processo, quando aplicável.

Atuar no monitoramento dos filtros ambientais e equipamentos produtivos, com autonomia de parada do processo e acionamento dos dispositivos de emergência em caso de riscos à segurança e meio ambiente.

Realizar medições e testes para liberação de materiais, segregando os lotes até que ocorra a liberação dos mesmos para produção e também testes de segurança operacional, para garantir a integridade dos equipamentos e processos.

Receber, movimentar, identificar, segregar e estocar materiais e ferramentas auxiliares diversas, checando peso, nota fiscal, estado e condições.

Movimentar e abastecer os materiais para as linhas de produção, conforme definidos nas ordens de produção.

Pesar, embalar, identificar, estocar e organizar os produtos intermediários e finais, registrar as informações em formulários de produção, registrando os dados coletados na produção assim como ocorrências relevantes durante todo o processo produtivo e encaminhar para gestão, de forma a garantir a segurança do processo e a qualidade do produto final.

Amostrar os materiais processados, garantindo a correta preparação dos materiais para a coleta de amostras representativas para a correta analise e quantificação de metais.

Utilizar equipamento de movimentação de carga envolvendo inclusive pá carregadeira, empilhadeira a gás e elétrica para a realização das atividades produtivas.

Participar das liberação de segurança dos equipamentos e das áreas, de forma a atender os requisitos de segurança da empresa para que ocorram as intervenções de manutenção ou de engenharia assim como o retornos destes para produção.

Solicitar materiais no almoxarifado e abrir notas de manutenção corretiva, utilizando o sistema integrado, buscando contribuir com as demandas administrativas do dia a dia.

Ensino médio completo;

Experiência em indústria metalúrgica, química ou semelhantes na área de produção;

Desejável conhecimento no pacote office;

Carteira de habilitação (CNH) válida;

Disponibilidade para trabalhar das13:30 às 22:26 de segunda a sexta-feira.

O que oferecemos

Nosso objetivo é estar à frente. Não apenas para nossos clientes, mas também para nossos funcionários. É por esse motivo que buscamos um ambiente colaborativo no qual todos possamos ter sucesso, promovendo uma cultura de compartilhamento de ideias, desenvolvimento de nossa capacidade e avanço em nossas carreiras. Estamos empenhados na construção de uma cultura inclusiva que ofereça oportunidades iguais para todos, independentemente de suas origens. Como seria de esperar de uma empresa líder mundial, também recompensaremos sua contribuição com salários e benefícios competitivos. Com tudo isso e muito mais, imagine, o que você poderia fazer?

Diversidade e Inclusão

Na Umicore, nos empenhamos na construção de um local de trabalho inclusivo e diverso que ofereça oportunidades iguais para todas as pessoas. Contratamos, independente de gênero, religião, raça, nacionalidade,etnia, origem cultural, grupo social, deficiência, orientação sexual, estado civil, idade e opinião política.

Valorizamos a singularidade de cada pessoa e acreditamos que a diversidade de pensamento nos ajuda a encontrar as soluções certas em um ambiente competitivo e dinâmico, afinal equipes diversificadas contribuem para ambientes mais criativos e inovadores e garantem o bem-estar de nossos colaboradores, tornando a Umicore um ótimo lugar para trabalhar.

Se você compartilha os mesmos valores inscreva-se para fazer parte da nossa equipe.

This role will contribute in designing and developing our platform to fulfil the business needs and to also improve our systems. Within this capacity you will have the chance to design new data pipelines, maintain platforms hosted on data streams for batch-loading and real-time visualisations.

Who are we looking for?

  • Maintaining and evolving our existing data platform;
  • Building processes to ingest data from Kafka, APIs and Databases using Nifi.
  • Applying transformations to data streams;
  • Being involved in data modelling following standards e.g. Inmon, Kimball, Data Vault;
  • Ensuring data quality by verifying data consistency and accuracy;
  • Keeping up to date on research and development of new technologies and techniques to enhance our data platform;
  • Have an investigative mindset to be able to troubleshoot – thinking outside the box when it comes to troubleshooting problems and incident management;
  • Full ownership on projects and tasks assigned together with being able to work within a Team;
  • Able to document well processes and perform knowledge sharing sessions

Some Key Requirements of what we would be looking for:

  • Experience with modern cloud database technologies such as Snowflake ;
  • Experience with orchestrating data pipelines using Airflow ;
  • Experience with SQL , and Data Integration Tools
  • Experience with any programming language like Python or Java;
  • Knowledge on AWS Services like S3/Lambda/API Gateways/DMS/RDS;
  • Development experience in both Microsoft , and Linux/Cloud environments;
  • Have strong analytical and problem-solving skills

It would be extra awesome if you also have experience with:

  • Familiar with Data Warehousing concepts and data modelling techniques such as Inmon, Kimball, Data Vault;
  • Familiar with data streaming using technologies such as Kafka ;
  • Familiar with software versioning tools like GIT ;
  • Familiar with infrastructure scripting like Terraform ;
  • Familiar with data flow systems such as Apache NiFi ;
  • Familiar with Data Monitoring and Visualisation tools such as Prometheus and Grafana, Cloudwatch ;
  • Scripting – Powershell, Unix Scripting;
  • At least 2 years experience in Data Engineering;
  • Excellent verbal and writing English communication skills;
  • Good learning mindset;
  • Able to set priorities and multitask

Why Betsson Group?

We get it, everyone is hiring! So what makes us different?

We have 60 years’ worth of knowledge in the iGaming industry. If you haven’t worked in this sector before – there are a few important things to know - it’s fast moving, it’s fun and above all it’s challenging as no two days are the same.

From our multi-brand, multi-market and multi-product offering, we are providing our customers with the best game play options around.

When it comes to our awesome Betssonites, we have over 70 different nationalities sitting in over 17 different global offices working as one team – we will let you interpret how diverse we are!

Learn more here about why you should seriously consider becoming our next Betssonite!

Hybrid Working Model

We believe to continue our 60 years of successful growth, collaboration is the key! Our hybrid working environment means, you will be based on-site in the office on Mondays , Wednesdays and Fridays and have the opportunity to work from home on Tuesdays and Thursdays – allowing you to connect with your colleagues both in person and colleagues from our international hubs in a sustainable way.

title: Pensions Implementation Technician
description:
Description

We are recruiting an experienced Pensions Implementation Technician with a proven track record of using technology and strong knowledge of data extraction, manipulation, and transformation to help clients resolve challenges with their pensions data.

The successful candidate will have experience in working with various pensions administration platforms and transferring of member data from those platforms, excellent knowledge of SQL, relational databases, and Excel. They will be able to assess the difficulties that a client’s data will present, then design and implement software tools and accompanying processes to resolve those challenges in a clearly documented and risk-managed way.

We are looking for a self-starter with plenty of energy who works and communicates well with the team. In addition to your own tasks, you will be expected to take responsibility for reviewing the programming work of others to ensure technical accuracy. Experience in the technology aspects of pension correction and rectification exercises, and data audits would be advantageous as well as hands-on experience in the software development cycle.

This role can be based out of our London, Reigate, Bristol, Birmingham, Manchester, Leeds or Edinburgh office working hybrid.

WTW’s Project & Data Solutions team brings a depth of experience and flexible resources to deliver the right solutions no matter how complex the requirements or large the defined benefit (DB) pension scheme is. No data project is the same and the team create and delivers solutions for wide-ranging issues and a varied customer base.

Project & Data Solutions delivers the right, cost-effective strategies and solutions for the following:

  • Guaranteed Minimum Pension (GMP) projects
  • Auditing data, benefits and calculations
  • Bulk data rectification and benefit (re-)construction
  • Data cleansing and improving electronic data
  • Supervising the data workstreams for de-risking projects so data is an enabler rather than a barrier.

What can we offer you? As an industry leader, we offer a generous salary and an excellent benefits package including pension, life insurance, medical insurance, eye care voucher and flexible benefits including critical illness cover, dental cover and many other options. We provide a defined career path with varied career opportunities as part of a dynamic team, encouraging and supporting our colleagues to tailor their roles to match their passions, strengths and aspirations.

At WTW, we trust you to know your work and the people, tools and environment you need to be successful. The majority of our colleagues work in a ”hybrid” style, with a mix of remote, in-person and in office interactions dependent on the needs of the team, role and clients. Our flexibility is rooted in trust and “hybrid” is not a one-size-fits-all solution. We understand flexibility is key to supporting an inclusive and diverse workforce and so we encourage requests for all types of flexible working as well as location-based arrangements. Please speak to your recruiter to discuss more.

Qualifications

The Requirements

  • Practical experience of a range of DB pension administration platforms, with an understanding of their structures and the difficulties of manipulating the member data
  • Excellent SQL skills and understanding of relational databases, including best practices in their use
  • Strong Excel skills
  • An ability to review and propose solutions to challenges with pension data, including leading software development teams
  • An ability to deliver multiple projects concurrently
  • Used to working in a fast-paced commercial environment where delivery to deadlines, budget and scope management are important
  • A clear, concise and skilled communicator of complex technology issues to a broad audience – good at maintaining project documentation and audit trails
  • Ability to work both as solo and in teams and enjoys a fast-paced environment
  • An ability to foster and support the delivery of projects within a team environment
  • Inquisitive, self-starter attitude and ability to work using own initiative

At WTW, we believe difference makes us stronger. We want our workforce to reflect the different and varied markets we operate in and to build a culture of inclusivity that makes colleagues feel welcome, valued and empowered to bring their whole selves to work every day. We are an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive work environment throughout our organisation. We embrace all types of diversity.

We’re committed to equal employment opportunity and provide application, interview and workplace adjustments and accommodations to all applicants. If you foresee any barriers, from the application process through to joining WTW, please email .
